description: Pull data from the Microsoft Power BI REST API for analysis in Claude. Read-only CLI for executing DAX queries, exporting reports, and browsing workspaces.

tools.name: apps_get
tools.description: Get a single Power BI app (a published bundle of dashboards and reports) by its ID. Required: appId (the app's GUID, obtained from apps_list). Returns the app's id, name, description, lastUpdate, workspaceId, and the count of dashboards and reports it contains.

tools.name: apps_list
tools.description: List the Power BI apps installed for the authenticated user. Apps are published bundles of dashboards and reports curated by workspace owners. Returns an array of {id, name, description, publishedBy, lastUpdate, workspaceId}. Use this to discover app IDs before calling apps_get, apps_list_dashboards, or apps_list_reports.

tools.name: apps_list_dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboards in an app. Required: appId.

tools.name: apps_list_reports
tools.description: List the reports in an app. Required: appId.

tools.name: dashboards_get_tiles_in_group
tools.description: List the tiles pinned to a dashboard. Required: groupId, dashboardId.

tools.name: dashboards_list_in_group
tools.description: List dashboards in a specific workspace. Required: groupId.

tools.name: dashboards_list_my
tools.description: List the dashboards in My workspace (the personal workspace of the authenticated user). Dashboards are pinned tile collections. Returns an array of {id, displayName, embedUrl, isReadOnly, webUrl}. For dashboards in a shared workspace, use dashboards_list_in_group with the workspace ID instead.

tools.name: dataflows_get_definition_in_group
tools.description: Get the dataflow definition (model.json with entities, M queries). Required: groupId, dataflowId.

tools.name: dataflows_list_in_group
tools.description: List dataflows in a specific workspace. Required: groupId.

tools.name: dataflows_transactions_in_group
tools.description: Get the transaction (refresh) history of a dataflow. Required: groupId, dataflowId.

tools.name: datasets_get_in_group
tools.description: Get a single dataset from a specific workspace. Required: groupId, datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_get_my
tools.description: Get a single dataset from My workspace. Required: datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_list_datasources_in_group
tools.description: List the datasources backing a dataset in a specific workspace. Required: groupId, datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_list_datasources_my
tools.description: List the datasources backing a dataset (My workspace). Required: datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_list_in_group
tools.description: List datasets in a specific workspace. Required: groupId.

tools.name: datasets_list_my
tools.description: List the datasets (semantic models) in My workspace (the personal workspace of the authenticated user). Datasets are what you query with DAX via the dax run command. Returns an array of {id, name, configuredBy, createdDate, isRefreshable, isEffectiveIdentityRequired}. For datasets in a shared workspace, use datasets_list_in_group with the workspace ID instead.

tools.name: datasets_parameters_in_group
tools.description: Get the parameters of a dataset in a specific workspace. Required: groupId, datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_parameters_my
tools.description: Get the parameters of a dataset (My workspace). Required: datasetId.

tools.name: datasets_refresh_history_in_group
tools.description: Get the recent refresh history of a dataset in a specific workspace. Required: groupId, datasetId. Optional: top.

params.name: top
params.description: Maximum number of refresh records to return.

tools.name: datasets_refresh_history_my
tools.description: Get the recent refresh history of a dataset (My workspace). Required: datasetId. Optional: top.

params.name: top
params.description: Maximum number of refresh records to return.

tools.name: groups_get
tools.description: Get a single workspace by ID. Required: groupId.

tools.name: groups_list
tools.description: List all workspaces (groups) the authenticated identity can access. Optional: top, filter.

params.name: top
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: filter
params.description: OData filter expression, e.g. name eq 'Sales'.

tools.name: reports_export_status_in_group
tools.description: Get the status of an export-to-file job. Required: groupId, reportId, exportId.

tools.name: reports_get_in_group
tools.description: Get a report from a specific workspace. Required: groupId, reportId.

tools.name: reports_get_my
tools.description: Get a report from My workspace. Required: reportId.

tools.name: reports_get_pages_in_group
tools.description: Get the pages of a Power BI report. Required: groupId, reportId.

tools.name: reports_list_in_group
tools.description: List reports in a specific workspace. Required: groupId.

tools.name: reports_list_my
tools.description: List the Power BI reports and paginated reports in My workspace (the personal workspace of the authenticated user). Returns an array of {id, name, datasetId, embedUrl, reportType, webUrl}. For reports in a shared workspace, use reports_list_in_group with the workspace ID instead.
